description: AWS Organizations operates in consolidated-billing-only mode
rationale: Organizations in CONSOLIDATED_BILLING mode cannot use organization-level policy controls such as SCPs. This finding is based on explicitly observed DescribeOrganization.FeatureSet; denied or unsupported access is incomplete, not compliant.
remediation: Evaluate enabling all AWS Organizations features and verify the organization-level policy controls, root states, and operational change-management requirements.
